_comment: Dedicated fixture for defeat_ally_alive. Identical to post_tutorial (warrior L1, met_relc, floodplains 7,6) EXCEPT rng_state, tuned so the level_up_loop-style route's FIGHT 2 (chieftains_raid, after fight1+sleep have advanced the rng) has the PC drop while Relc survives -- the canonical PC-death-defeat scenario. Separate fixture so its rng can differ from post_tutorial's (which level_up_loop pins to a fight-2 WIN). TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=6, captured .state = -7039256646584150880) -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. Seeds 1-5 change fight 2's outcome (WIN, or Relc also downed) and break the exact PC-dies-Relc-lives-at-full-40hp shape this fixture proves; seed=6 is the first that preserves it.
